scene: The unlocked chest reveals three travel tokens as transit vehicles arrive overhead.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the zinc roof terrace. Far left, an open-chested brass pastry robot stands by a yellow flying scooter. Left of centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit holds three glowing transit tokens, dog beside her. Centre, a red double-decker hover bus hovers. Far right, a striped gondola drone floats beside a rooftop chimney.
shown: a sleek yellow flying scooter parked on a launch ramp on the left
a red double-decker hover bus hovering with open doors at centre
a hovering striped gondola drone moored to a ring on the right
